bas_payg_labels.description: gst_only: the review covers GST. payg_withholding: the BAS also reports PAYG withheld (W1, W2). payg_withholding_and_instalments: also PAYG instalments (T7 / 5A). The review checks GST only; the summary says which PAYG labels must be checked in payroll.
bas_payg_labels.title: PAYG on this practice's BAS

material_question_amount.description: A client question from the previous review that is still open becomes a Stop when it is about GST or about an amount at or above this. Below it, it is a Note. 0 makes every open question a Stop.
material_question_amount.title: Unanswered client questions: Stop at or above ($)

prior_period_from.description: previous_review: the date the previous BAS review for the client was approved. lock_date: the client's lock date in Xero (the date the previous period was closed), falling back to the previous review when there is no lock date.
prior_period_from.title: Prior-period adjustments: look for changes since

description: Connect Xero (required; a shared service connection for a team agent) and, optionally, ABR Lookup for the ABN register checks, then choose three BAS review settings (each has a default). The manager is named when the agent is activated. Reports load their data as the person who opens them, so reviewers need their own Xero access to the client.
name: Client Reporting Agent setup
